referenceProvenance.identity: The OG blue Yunidragon: a slender upright long-necked baby dragon, large amber-brown eyes, a broad cyan forehead crest with blue spots, blue cheek and dorsal surfaces with light mint-cyan underbelly, coral-red layered ear fins, four short clawed legs, a long tapering tail, and the recognizable OG facial features. Preserve these distinctive markings and body proportions; do not turn it into a stocky winged dragon or another animal.

backgroundModifier: meadow-blue: preserve rolling green hills, a clear azure sky, soft clouds and the distant windmill

prompts.creature:
Create a 1024 x 1024 PNG character reference by EDITING the attached OG Yunipals monster.
This exact character is the identity reference, not merely a style example.
IDENTITY TO PRESERVE: The OG blue Yunidragon: a slender upright long-necked baby dragon, large amber-brown eyes, a broad cyan forehead crest with blue spots, blue cheek and dorsal surfaces with light mint-cyan underbelly, coral-red layered ear fins, four short clawed legs, a long tapering tail, and the recognizable OG facial features. Preserve these distinctive markings and body proportions; do not turn it into a stocky winged dragon or another animal.
Preserve its species, face, eye shape, silhouette, body proportions, limb count, tail,
ears, distinctive head structures and recognizable markings. Keep the original soft
painted 3D collectible rendering style. Do not invent a new species or evolve it.
TARGET TYPE: Yunidragon. PRIMARY BODY COLOR: Blue.
Recolor its main body surfaces to this color; keep recognizable secondary markings
and natural eye colors. The primary color must be unmistakable.
FOREHEAD HORN: exactly one clearly visible DIAMOND horn: an elongated faceted crystal spike, with crisp flat diamond-cut planes, an icy translucent ivory surface, and NO spiral ridges, naturally attached at the center of the forehead.
Replace the existing forehead horn with this requested horn. Preserve other anatomical
features of the OG reference; do not add extra unicorn horns.
GLITTER = YES: the colored body contains clearly visible fine iridescent glitter microflakes, bright tiny silver-blue prismatic glints embedded in its surface. Keep the base body color dominant and its face readable.
Full body, open eyes, centered, friendly expression and the OG character's recognizable
stance. Use a clean soft neutral studio background and a small ground shadow.
Only one monster. No text, no logo, no card frame, no accessories, no extra characters.
prompts.card:
Create one finished 1024 x 1536 PNG YUNIPALS collectible card, portrait 2:3.
Reference image #1 is the EXACT Yunidragon character to preserve.
Reference image #2 supplies ONLY the OG meadow background: green hills, blue sky,
soft clouds and the small distant windmill. Do not copy its original monster.
Reference image #3 is the YUNIPALS logo badge; preserve its recognizable design.
Seat the character from image #1 naturally in that cheerful painted-3D meadow.
Keep the same face, anatomy, body color, Diamond horn and
visible body glitter.
The creature is large and readable, its complete body, horn and tail inside the frame.
CARD DESIGN: a clean premium warm-gold rounded frame, a pale frosted-glass header
and matching bottom nameplate, soft painterly lighting, rich but coherent colors.
Place the supplied logo badge at the left of the header. Exact header: YUNIPALS.
Exact bottom name: YUNIDRAGON. These are the only text elements.
No level badge, statistics, numbers, rarity symbols, ability text or invented labels.
This stage is a NON-HOLOGRAPHIC base card. Preserve requested glitter on the creature
when present, but do not add whole-card rainbow foil yet.
OUTPUT: one upright card with clean rounded corners on a FULLY TRANSPARENT exterior,
no surrounding canvas color, no exterior glow, no drop shadow, no halo. The card fills
most of the image with a small equal transparent margin and an intact gold outer border.
prompts.foil:
Edit this exact finished 1024 x 1536 YUNIPALS card to add a holographic finish.
Keep the SAME Yunidragon identity, Blue color, Diamond horn,
pose, meadow scene, framing, logo, typography and card dimensions.
GLITTER = YES has TWO visible properties: the monster's body has fine embedded glitter,
and the card art has a luxurious prismatic holographic foil overlay. Preserve and make
readable the body glitter. Add tasteful rainbow refraction, fine diagonal holographic
sheen and small sparkling glints over the art, while keeping the original body color
and face recognizable. Leave the gold border, logo and text crisp and unobscured.
Exact header YUNIPALS, exact bottom name YUNIDRAGON; no extra text.
Preserve the transparent exterior and clean rounded silhouette. No exterior halo,
no shadow or opaque background. Output one 1024 x 1536 PNG with transparency.

visualReview.note: Checked OG facial identity and anatomy, requested horn shape and body glitter, full-body framing and legible title; inspected card and foil silhouettes on white, black and checkerboard. No exterior halo, clipped border or visible canvas-edge pixels. Human approval remains pending.
